name: How long does a typical shower glass installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower glass installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation of shower glass typically takes one to two days, depending on the complexity of the design and the preparation required. This timeline accounts for precise measurements, custom glass cutting, and careful sealing. The actual time on site may be shorter if all preparatory work, such as tile installation and curing, is completed beforehand. We aim to minimize disruption while ensuring a high-quality finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical shower glass installation takes one to two days, depending on the design and site preparation, with minimal disruption.
